about: Kurumoch: Samara International Airport. Managed by Aeroporty Regionov management company. More than 80 destinations, more than 30 Russian and international airlines.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: City bus No. 222 runs from Samara railway station, journey time about 1 hour. Route No. 78 runs from Barboshina Polyana, about 1 hour, on weekdays. Intercity No. 607 connects the airport with Samara (railway station) and Tolyatti, 50–80 minutes, 265 ₽. No. 333 and No. 652Т also run from Tolyatti.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic and international lounges on Level 4. Admits business class passengers, members of airline loyalty programmes and anyone who pays for the visit: 5,800 ₽ for up to 3 hours, child 2–12 years 2,900 ₽. Lounge for ON PASS, Grey Wall, EveryLounge, Persona.Aero, RusPriority, GoldenKey programmes in the domestic departure area, Level 3.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Automated left luggage on Level 1, to the right of the entrance, by the airline ticket offices. Standard locker 250 ₽ per hour or 550 ₽ per day. Large 350 ₽ per hour or 900 ₽ per day. Oversized baggage 1,200 ₽ per item.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 3, open round the clock. Admits children under 7, or under 14 with disabilities, only with an adult. A certificate from the first-aid post on Level 1, a passport and a ticket are required. Up to 12 hours before departure and up to 6 hours after arrival.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: In the drop-off and pick-up zone the first 15 minutes are free, from minute 16 to 60: 880 ₽. Short-stay P1: up to an hour 357 ₽, up to 2 hours 682 ₽, a day 1,391 ₽. Long-stay P2: a day 791 ₽. Economy P4: 1,054 ₽ for the first 2 days. All car parks are open round the clock.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: The free Free_KUF network covers the passenger areas of the terminal. Login with a mobile phone number, then follow the on-screen instructions.
